title: Fix the Undersized Malloc Allocation
description: The program should allocate an array of 5 integers on the heap and fill it.
expectedBehavior: The program should safely allocate space for 5 ints and print 40, the last value stored.
actualProblem: malloc(sizeof(int)) only allocates enough memory for a single int, not an array of 5. Writing to arr[1] through arr[4] goes past the allocated block, corrupting unrelated heap memory (undefined behavior).
explanation: When allocating an array on the heap, the requested size must account for every element: n * sizeof(elementType), not just the size of one element.
